marketBrief.headline: Week ahead: October CPI on Tuesday after a chip rout and partial rebound
marketBrief.summary: Markets were closed Saturday. Friday's close (as of Nov. 6): the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.09% to 24,579.42 and the S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86, while the Dow fell 237.33 points to 51,285.73 (CNBC live updates). The week still closed lower for all three indexes. October CPI is the main data event on Tuesday, Nov. 10, and the December hike odds sit near 76.8% after the 165,000-job report.

Week to Friday: Nasdaq -3.37%, S&P 500 -2.68%, Dow -0.94% (Investrade closing recap).
Tuesday, Nov. 10: October CPI and core CPI (dates tentative per Schaeffer's Research).
